## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this is the smallest useful change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a focused test
- [ ] No credentials, prompts, provider bodies, or capability URLs are included

## Risk

Describe protocol, config, credential, compatibility, or rollout risk. Write `Low` with a reason when none is notable.

## Model evidence

For model-profile changes, link current official discovery evidence and describe live text, tool, `apply_patch`, reasoning, and error-path results. Otherwise write `Not applicable`.
